LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECT AT SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Economic Activities
Topic 4.3: Enterprise Project at School

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Enterprise Project at School. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LEARN

QUALITIES OF GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL Hallo learner, welcome to a social studies lesson grade 4. Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school.

Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies grade 4 lesson. Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. I hope you have the book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about community leadership in our county. What does a community leader do in the county? I hope you were able to answer what a community leader does. Very good. A community leader: Teaches people about good values in the society. Examples of values are honesty, loyalty, kindness, truthfulness and so on. Community leader solves problems in the community. They guide people to know what is right and wrong. They lead people in prayers and worship. They make sure the culture and traditions of the community are not forgotten. They lead people in cultural events in the community. Now that we have said what a community leader does, Let’s get to today’s topic. We shall talk about qualities of good citizenship in school. Now who is a citizen? Very good, a citizen is a person who belongs to a particular place or country. Now let us look at what is citizenship? Citizenship is the act of belonging to a country and enjoying the rights that the citizens of that country enjoy. What can you do in school to make you a good learner? Answer when you hear the Very good, we do things like: Help one another in doing various things. Keeping the school clean. Being at peace with others at all times. Sharing with one another. What are some the good qualities of learners in school? Answer when you hear the. Very good, I hope you have said some of the qualities. I will now say some good qualities of learners in school. A good learner should be kind to others. A good learner should be honest. A good learner should be caring. A good learner should be obedient. A good learner should be responsible. A good learner should be hardworking. A good learner should be humble. A good learner should be tolerant. You can mention more if you have any.

I am now going to read out qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any bad qualities of a learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. I repeat, write down if you hear any bad quality of a learner. Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the bad qualities that you have heard? Very good, from our list, the following are the bad qualities of a bad learner. Disobedient, lazy, rude, irresponsible, a bully, greedy and selfish. Before doing something, we should always ask ourselves the following questions. Question 1 Will my teacher be happy with what I am going to do? Question 2 Will my parents be happy with what I am going to do? Question 3 Will what I am going to do help other learners in school? Question 4 Will what I am going to do help me do well in school? When we practice good citizenship in school, there is good performance. Things in school are taken well care of and there is peace and harmony. I am now going to read out good qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any qualities of a good learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the good qualities that you have heard? Let me read them again. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. I hope you have written the following words: Kind, honest, caring, tolerant, hardworking and humble. Learner, show how you can be a good child at home. With that, we have now come to the end of the lesson for today.

You have been listening to a social studies programme for grade 4 learners. Your radio teacher was Eugene Kimani. This programme was recorded by John Mbiti. Until next time, Goodbye.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Enterprise Project at School means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Enterprise Project at School.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Enterprise Project at School
2. Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
3. Learning materials: PROGRAMME_10 QUALITIES OF GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL; PROGRAMME_2 THE SCHOOL; SST_PROGRAMME_12 FACTORS OR REASONS THAT PROMOTE PEACE IN SCHOOL
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
